entries.name: canopy
entries.doc: Canopy's API for this mod.

entries.name: canopy.save
entries.doc: Values kept with the save being played.

entries.name: canopy.items
entries.doc: The mod's own custom items.

entries.name: canopy.flags
entries.doc: The mod's own flags.

entries.name: canopy.log
entries.doc: Writes one line to Canopy.log as [key] text. Arguments are turned into text and joined with spaces, like print, which does the same. Line breaks become spaces, and a line is cut after 1000 bytes.

entries.name: canopy.key
entries.doc: The mod key, and true for an unsafe mod.

entries.name: canopy.unsafe
entries.doc: The mod key, and true for an unsafe mod.

entries.name: canopy.setting
entries.doc: The current value of a setting from canopy.ini: true or false for a toggle, a number for a slider, the choice's text for a choice. nil for a key the mod did not declare. Read it when you need it: it changes as soon as the player changes it on the Mod Settings page.

entries.name: canopy.save.get
entries.doc: The value stored under key with the save being played, or default when there is none. A value that reads as a whole number comes back as a number, anything else as a string.

entries.name: canopy.save.set
entries.doc: Stores a whole number, a string or a boolean (stored as 1 or 0) under key with the save being played. nil deletes the key. Returns true when it was stored. Values are written to mods\CanopyData\slot<N>.ini when the game saves, never into the game's own save. key follows the setting key rules, a string is one line of at most 1024 bytes, and a mod keeps at most 1024 values. The rules and file format are the same as for DLL mods: see Per-save data.

entries.name: canopy.save.has
entries.doc: has is true when key has a value. delete removes it and is true when there was one.

entries.name: canopy.save.delete
entries.doc: has is true when key has a value. delete removes it and is true when there was one.

entries.name: canopy.on
entries.doc: Adds a handler for one of the events. An unknown event name is an error.

entries.name: canopy.in_game
entries.doc: true while a save is loaded and the player is on the map with control. Game commands only work while this is true.

entries.name: canopy.wait
entries.doc: Only inside main: waits frames in-game frames, 1 when left out.

entries.name: canopy.items.give
entries.doc: give puts count (1 to 999, 1 when left out) of the item in the bag, the way a found item goes in, with the game's "got an item" line. It returns how many went in. When none did, it returns 0 and the reason, such as a full bag, or not being in game. It only works while canopy.in_game() is true.

entries.name: canopy.items.count
entries.doc: count is how many the player has in the bag and tool slots.

entries.name: canopy.items.id
entries.doc: id is the item's id in the game's item table.

entries.name: canopy.items.on_use
entries.doc: Sets the function that runs when the player uses the mod's item key, which must have use = script in its [item.<key>] section. Any other item, or a key the mod did not define, is an error. A second call for the same item replaces the handler.

entries.name: canopy.flags.get
entries.doc: get is true or false. Outside a game it returns false and the reason.

entries.name: canopy.flags.set
entries.doc: set turns the flag on or off through the game's own flag write and returns true. on must be true or false. When it cannot set the flag, such as while the game is saving or outside a game, it returns false and the reason.

entries.name: canopy.flags.id
entries.doc: id is the flag's id in the game's flag set, from 95000 to 99998.

entries.name: require
entries.doc: Loads lua\<name>.lua from the mod's own folder, once, into the mod's environment, and returns what it returned (true when it returned nothing). Dots are folders: require("util.text") loads lua\util\text.lua. Names are letters, digits and _, with dots between folders, up to 64 characters. Nothing outside the mod's lua folder can be loaded.

entries.name: title
entries.doc: The title screen appears. Per-save values are already cleared.

entries.name: save_loaded
entries.doc: A save finished loading, before the player has control. The per-save values of that save are already read.

entries.name: control
entries.doc: The player got control on a map: after a load, an event, a menu or a loading screen.

entries.name: no_control
entries.doc: The player lost control: a menu, dialog, event or loading screen took over.

entries.name: frame
entries.doc: Every frame while in game. Called with no arguments.
